Chiang Mai 3 places · area 1 of 1

  1. 1 Must see within Chiang Mai

    Wat Phra That Doi Suthep

    The gold-chedi mountain temple above Chiang Mai, reached by a 300-step naga staircase — the city's emblem.

    Look for Buddhist temple

    Doi Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, Thailand

    Recommended by ,

  2. 2 Worth the detour within Chiang Mai · Thai

    Khao Soi Khun Yai

    The tiny lunch-only stall locals most often name as Chiang Mai's best khao soi; also a Mark Wiens pick.

    Near Wat Kuan Kama, Sithiwongse Road, Old City, Chiang Mai, Thailand

    Recommended by , ,

  3. 3 Worth the detour within Chiang Mai

    Chiang Mai Old City Temples (Wat Chedi Luang & Wat Phra Singh)

    The walled Old City's Lanna temples — the ruined 14th-century Chedi Luang and the revered Wat Phra Singh.

    Look for Historic temples

    Old City (within the moat), Chiang Mai, Thailand

    Recommended by ,

How we choose

Every place is recommended by named sources (review-aggregator star ratings never count as the recommender), pinned to its door from a published coordinate, and status-checked. Closed places stay, flagged, so you know they’re gone.
